name: github-sources
description: Copies selected GitHub repositories into read-only Mounts for the chat agent.

configuration.description: Repos to copy, mount name and interval. Any plugin manager can add a repo the token can read. Workspace readers can read the copy. Use a read-only token limited to these repos.
configuration.defaultYaml:
mount:
  name: github
schedule:
  everyMinutes: 1440
repositories:
  - owner: raythurnvoid
    repo: experiment--t3-chat
    ref: main
    volumeKey: t3-chat

mounts.description: Read-only copies of the GitHub repositories listed in the settings.

secrets.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
secrets.description: Optional but recommended. Use a fine-grained token with Contents read access only to the chosen repositories. Private repositories need it.
